segments.ja353:1.1: Nayidaṃ niccaṃ bhavitabbaṃ brahmadatta, khemaṃ subhikkhaṃ sukhatā ca kāye;
segments.ja353:1.3: Atthaccaye mā ahu sampamūḷho, bhinnaplavo sāgarasseva majjhe.
segments.ja353:2.1: Yāni karoti puriso, tāni attani passati;
segments.ja353:2.5: Yādisaṃ vapate bījaṃ, tādisaṃ harate phalaṃ.
segments.ja353:3.3: Mā su [mā ssu (sī. syā. pī.)] tvaṃ akari pāpaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ pacchā kataṃ tape.
segments.ja353:4.1: Ayameva so piṅgiya [so piṅgiyo (syā.), sopi bhiyyo (ka.)] venasākho,[dhonasākho (ka. sī. pī.)] yamhi ghātayiṃ khattiyānaṃ sahassaṃ;
segments.ja353:4.3: Alaṅkate candanasārānulitte, tameva dukkhaṃ paccāgataṃ mamaṃ.
segments.ja353:5.1: Sāmā ca [sāmāpi (sī. syā.)] kho candanalittagattā [gattī (ka. sī. syā. pī.)], laṭṭhīva sobhañjanakassa uggatā;
segments.ja353:5.3: Adisvā [adisvāva (sī.)] kālaṃ karissāmi ubbariṃ, taṃ me ito dukkhataraṃ bhavissatīti.
